inlines.v: RESCIND', verb transitive [Latin rescindo; re and scindo; to cut.] 1. To abrogate; to revoke; to annul; to vacate an act by the enacting authority or by superior authority; as, to rescind a law, a resolution or a vote; to rescind an edict or decree; to rescind a judgment. 2. To cut off. [Not used.]
